narrative.offerRewardText: Zul'jin would be envious, champion. Go forth and conquer!
narrative.requestItemsText: King Rastakhan sends his regards, Master adventurer. Such an honor has never been given to one outside the Zandalar tribe.<Jin'rokh bows.>Give me your talisman so that I may enhance it once more. Know that the Rage of Mugamba is now intrinsically connected to your very soul.
